description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.


Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
  • Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
  • Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
  • Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
  • Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
  • Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
  • Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.
  • Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure, SaaS vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC2, or ISO 22301.
  • Prior involvement in DR tabletop exercises


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico

  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)


Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.


DON'T USE AI FOR QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS -

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: CLM Functional Support Analyst
description:

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven organization where people, purpose, and technology come together to create meaningful impact. With a strong people-first culture, we empower our teams to innovate, collaborate, and grow while delivering value to our clients and communities worldwide.



We 're looking for aCLM Functional Support Analyst to provides functional support for Contract Lifecycle Management platforms, handling incidents and service requests, supporting end users, and ensuring smooth contract operations across legal, procurement, and business teams.

  • Provide functional support for CLM-related incidents and service requests (L1/L2).
  • Log, categorize, prioritize, and track tickets using ITSM tools.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting and functional analysis before escalating to L2/L3 or technical teams.

  • Perform basic CLM system configuration (templates, fields, workflows, user roles).
  • Monitor CLM integrations with ERP/CRM systems and identify data synchronization issues.
  • Support UAT activities, regression testing, and release validation.
  • Maintain user documentation and knowledge base articles.
  • Provide end-user training and onboarding support.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in CLM functional support or functional analysis roles.
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle processes and legal/procurement workflows.
  • Experience with CLM platforms such as Icertis, Agiloft, Conga, Sirion, SAP Ariba, or similar.

Why Join UST?

At UST, you will work in a collaborative and inclusive environment where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. You will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, work with global teams, and build solutions that truly make a difference.

UST is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Equity Employer . We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.

  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

E você, quer fazer a diferença e transformar a saúde de milhares de famílias brasileiras com a gente?

Quer fazer parte de um time inovador dentro da maior empresa de saúde da América do Sul?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de RH - HR Business Partner (HRBP) com experiência generalista nos subsistemas de RH e perfil consultivo para atuar de forma estratégica.

A posição atua como ponte entre liderança e time, conectando as necessidades do negócio às dos profissionais. Garante consistência de gestão e desenvolvimento, fortalece cultura e engajamento, alinhando performance e resultados.


O profissional terá atuação transversal, apoiando diferentes frentes na unidade de negócio. Contribuirá para o planejamento das áreas e para a evolução de processos e práticas de Pessoas & Cultura, com foco em eficiência operacional e na qualidade da experiência do colaborador, com forte habilidade em leitura de dados e cenários. ✨


Principais requisitos / O que você precisa ter:


- Formação: Administração, Psicologia, Gestão de RH, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;

-Experiência prévia como HRBP ou atuação generalista com perfil estratégico.

-Vivência prática em múltiplos subsistemas (ex.: Clima & Cultura, T&D e R&S).

-Capacidade de atuação consultiva e estratégica, com boa leitura de negócio e foco em execução.

-Experiência comprovada atuando com times em níveis de senioridade diferentes.

-Forte habilidade de comunicação, escuta ativa, influência e relacionamento interpessoal.

-Capacidade de atuar com visão de negócio (prioridades, linguagem empresarial, métricas e impacto).

-Familiaridade com orçamento de postos de trabalho e linha de custo de pessoal.

-Organização e priorização para lidar com múltiplas demandas e stakeholders.


Dia-a-dia / aqui você vai:


-Atuar como parceiro (a) das lideranças, apoiando decisões e rotinas de gestão de pessoas (estrutura, desempenho, desenvolvimento, movimentações, rituais e cultura).

-Mapear necessidades das áreas e transformá-las em planos e ações alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio.

-Planejar e conduzir iniciativas de clima, cultura, engajamento e experiência do colaborador, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de alta performance.

-Planejar e conduzir ações de Treinamento Desenvolvimento (levantamento de necessidades, trilhas, programas, rituais e acompanhamento);

-Liderar a comunicação interna, conectando áreas e frentes de negócio, promovendo transparência, alinhamento e engajamento.

-Fazer interface com as áreas especialistas para garantir fluidez de informações e processos de Gente e Gestão.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e liderar iniciativas de padronização e otimização de processos de RH, visando eficiência, clareza e governança.


O que oferecemos:

•Remuneração: Salário compatível + Benefícios + Bônus;

•Local de trabalho: Presencial - Hospital Quinta D'Or - São Cristóvão/RJ;

• Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - 2ªf a 5ªf de 8h às 18h / 6ªf de 8h às 17h.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.

  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js / RoR)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails to join the core development team of our U.S. client. You will design, build, and deliver the best financial software on the planet!


Our client is a fintech company that provides commodities managers with task automation and timely insights on their trades, including risk exposure, positions, and profits and losses. With over 5 million trades on its SaaS platform, the company is an award-winning industry leader that counts some of the world's largest financial firms as customers. Our client is growing rapidly and is looking for smart, bold risk-takers to further its product strategy of market disruption and expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and test new features for the clients next-gen trading platform
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and reusable code
  • Utilize AI tooling, such as Cursor and CodeRabbit, to accelerate software development
  • Participate in and support the full continuous testing and delivery pipeline
  • Join the engineering support rotation, assisting the Customer Success team
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and feature tests
  • Review code and tests written by other team members
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt
  • Accept, act on, and provide feedback in a timely manner
  • Seek and provide timely technical assistance and clarification.
  • Collaborate with and mentor team members
  • Learn new technologies (and help your teammates learn them too)
  • Support the clients growth by contributing to open-source projects and representing the client within the developer community


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 3+ years of experience developing full stack applications with React.js and Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with TypeScript, SQL-compliant databases, Go, Python, or other open-source and commercial technologies, such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
  • Proficient in the use of AI tooling such as Cursor and GitHub CoPilot
  • Experience with high-volume, event-based system architectures and Agile software development practices
  • A self-disciplined, task-oriented approach to development, testing, and code structure
  • Desire to work in an environment that:
  • Embraces diversity
  • Maintains a client-centric approach to building products
  • Strives to maintain a world-class organization
  • Loves technology
  • Gives back to the community
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and bring order from chaos
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, transparent, and fun


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in Computer Science, a related field of study, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in finance and/or energy, commodities, or equity trading
  • Experience with enterprise-grade software and highly secure, multi-tenant SaaS solutions
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with real-time, data-streaming technologies such as Kafka
  • Experience with Ember


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Tech Lead | Marketplace
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead para evoluir um Marketplace digital de plataforma, com impacto direto na expansão do ecossistema, na geração de valor e na experiência dos clientes.

O desafio envolve evoluir uma plataforma de produtos digitais integrada, escalável e orientada a crescimento. Como Tech Lead, você terá papel central em transformar visão de produto em soluções técnicas sustentáveis e prontas para escala.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução de produtos de plataforma, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura, equilibrando integração, autonomia e experiência unificada.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e contribuir hands-on com o time.
  • Trabalhar próximo a produto e stakeholders, apoiando decisões e trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, promovendo boas práticas e excelência técnica.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção de produtos digitais de plataforma, como marketplaces, portais ou ecossistemas orientados a crescimento (PQL / PLG).
  • Forte base em arquitetura de software e sistemas distribuídos, aplicando Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Vivência sólida em backend distribuído, com microserviços em Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot), APIs REST e contratos OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e comunicação assíncrona, garantindo resiliência e consistência entre serviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL) e modelagem orientada a domínio.
  • Vivência com observabilidade em sistemas distribuídos, incluindo métricas e rastreamento ponta a ponta.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud, com CI/CD, containers e múltiplos ambientes.
  • Conhecimento de frontend moderno, incluindo React e TypeScript.
  • Atuação como Tech Lead, definindo padrões técnicos e orientando times de engenharia.
  • Experiência prévia com marketplaces digitais ou plataformas de monetização.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade avançada, performance e escalabilidade
  • Atuação em produtos com integrações complexas e múltiplos domínios de negócio.

title: Project Manager
description:
Join Aditi Consulting as a Project Manager!


Summary:

We are seeking a Project Manager to support a global M&A divestiture initiative involving the disposition of 150+ applications across multiple regions, including significant collaboration with teams in Japan . This role requires ERP experience (SAP, Epicor, ETQ, Reliance, or similar), strong technical communication skills, and the ability to manage tight timelines driven by Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) .

Responsibilities:

  • Lead global application disposition efforts across multiple waves of work.
  • Manage timelines tied to TSA deadlines to avoid costly extensions.
  • Coordinate closely with technical teams on integrations, workflows, and decommissioning plans.
  • Work with sourcing, suppliers, purchasing, and invoicing teams to ensure vendor alignment.
  • Facilitate meetings with global stakeholders, including late-night sessions with Japan-based teams (flex schedule provided).
  • Drive project planning, risk management, documentation, and status reporting.
  • Ensure smooth communication and alignment across business, IT, and regional teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • Proven Project Management experience in M&A divestiture environments.
  • Familiarity with Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) .
  • Experience with at least one ERP or enterprise platform (SAP, Epicor, ETQ, Reliance, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of sourcing, suppliers, purchasing, and invoicing processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills , including the ability to follow technical integration discussions.
  • Experience working with global or cross-cultural teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project Management certification (PMP, Prince2, Agile/Scrum).
  • Experience collaborating with Japan or APAC teams.
  • Background in application disposition, decommissioning, or IT transformation.
  • Knowledge of integration workflows and system dependencies.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in complex technical environments.
  • Proactive risk identification and problem-solving.
  • High level of organization and multitasking in fast-paced settings.
  • Flexibility and adaptability when working across global time zones.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;

title: Pessoa Engenheira de IA
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de AI exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT).
  • Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines.
  • Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas).
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: SharePoint Developer (SPFx & Power Platform)
description:

We are seeking an experienced SharePoint Developer with strong expertise in SharePoint Online, SPFx, Nintex, and the Power Platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing customized SharePoint solutions, workflows, and business applications while supporting migrations and system integrations.

This role requires strong development skills in ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, Web APIs, and SQL Server, along with experience in automation and modern SharePoint frameworks.

  • Create and manage workflows using Power Automate
  • Build business applications using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven)
  • Develop and consume RESTful Web APIs

  • Perform SharePoint migrations (On-Prem to Online, File Share to SharePoint)
  • Develop backend components using ASP.NET, C#, and .NET Framework/Core
  • Write and optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and views
  • Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell (PnP PowerShell)
  • Participate in solution architecture, requirement gathering, and technical documentation
  • Ensure compliance with governance, security, and best practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 3+ years of experience in SharePoint development
  • Strong experience with:
  • SharePoint Online & SharePoint Server
  • SPFx Framework
  • Nintex (Workflows & Forms)
  • Power Automate & Power Apps
  • ASP.NET / C#
  • JavaScript, HTML, CSS
  • SQL Server
  • Experience developing and consuming Web APIs
  • Experience with SharePoint migrations (ShareGate)
  • Strong knowledge of SharePoint security and permissions model
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting
  • Familiarity with Azure AD authentication and Microsoft Graph API


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps)
  • Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of React and modern front-end frameworks
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Microsoft certifications (SharePoint, Power Platform, Azure)


Technical Skills Summary

  • SharePoint Online & On-Prem
  • SPFx (React/TypeScript)
  • Nintex Workflows
  • Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
  • ASP.NET / C#
  • Web API Development
  • JavaScript / HTML / CSS
  • SQL Server
  • PowerShell
  • SharePoint Migrations

title: Assistente de Equipamentos (Exclusivo para PCDs)

Este profissional atuará no inventário físico, recebimento e identificação de equipamentos, atualização de sistemas, preservação, movimentação segura e preparação de materiais para Workshop e embarques offshore. É uma função essencial para assegurar organização, conformidade técnica e fluxo eficiente dos equipamentos no ciclo operacional.

  • Acompanhar o retorno de equipamentos do Workshop, realizando conferência física e sistêmica e reportando eventuais desvios.
  • Suportar a preparação de equipamentos para embarques offshore, garantindo conformidade com requisitos técnicos e padrões de qualidade.
  • Reportar desvios operacionais, anomalias técnicas e inconsistências de inventário aos Coordenadores de forma tempestiva.
  • Cumprir normas e diretrizes de segurança, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho organizado e disciplinado.


Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Formação Técnica Completa nas áreas de Mecânica, Eletrônica, Automação, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas (obrigatório).
  • Desejável Ensino Superior em Administração, Engenharia e/ou áreas afins.

Essa oportunidade é exclusiva para profissionais com deficiência e/ou reabilitadas pelo INSS.

Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).

  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.

title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer

About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

  • Definir e coordenar a matriz de riscos dos elementos de obras industriais, antecipando falhas potenciais em interfaces disciplinares, riscos de montagem mecânica, riscos de segurança operacional, desvios de performance dos equipamentos e impactos financeiros;
  • Assegurar a execução com qualidade dos serviços, garantindo conformidade com especificações técnicas, normas internacionais aplicáveis, metodologias executivas específicas que atendam aos requisitos operacionais da planta em construção;
  • Compatibilizar o projeto com o escopo contratual, analisando a viabilidade das metodologias de montagem, interligações de sistemas e sequenciamento construtivo, otimizando soluções técnicas para reduzir custos, retrabalhos e riscos de parada ou atraso de startup;
  • Atuar em parceria com Suprimentos na especificação técnica e aquisição de materiais e equipamentos, buscando fornecedores internacionais, garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade normativa, custo-benefício e gestão eficiente de estoque e entregas;
  • Aplicar conhecimentos das principais modalidades contratuais utilizadas em obras industriais, desenhando estratégias adequadas para cada contexto e suas interfaces multidisciplinares, mantendo profundo conhecimento do contrato;
  • Elaborar e sustentar reinvindicações (claims) e aditivos, quando necessário, visando a manutenção do equilíbrio contratual e a proteção dos indicadores de performance do projeto;
  • Realizar a gestão contratual rigorosa com subcontratados, assegurando cumprimento de obrigações técnicas, regulatórias e de SMS, mitigando passivos e garantindo medições precisas, rastreáveis e conformes ao avanço físico real;
  • Compreender o desempenho econômico-financeiro de projetos industriais, analisando CAPEX, OPEX, curva S integrada por disciplina, impactos de equipamentos estratégicos e variações cambiais em contratos internacionais.
  • Manter relacionamento transparente com sindicatos, órgãos reguladores, Corpo de Bombeiros, órgãos ambientais e auditorias técnicas, garantindo observância à legislação trabalhista, NR’s e normas industriais aplicáveis, preservando a segurança empresarial;
  • Priorizar a Segurança do Trabalho desde as fases de engenharia até a execução, implantando cultura de intolerância a acidentes, gestão de energias perigosas, análises de risco operacionais e práticas avançadas de controle de processo;
  • Coordenar atividades de pré-comissionamento e completação mecânica, desenvolve planos e procedimentos de comissionamento, manuais de operação e manutenção, matrizes de testes e controles rigorosos de qualidade e riscos operacionais;
  • Planejar e gerenciar a partida da planta industrial, coordenando testes operacionais, energização de sistemas elétricos, calibração de instrumentos, testes de performance e integração com a equipe de operação, garantindo entrega segura e funcional ao cliente.

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Civil, Elétrica, Produção ou correlatas;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência como Site Manager em obras do ramo industrial, sobretudo em plantas químicas e/ou petroquímicas;
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

Queremos conocerte.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.
